# Copilot instructions for this repository

This repository is a demonstration project for GitHub Copilot Spaces.

## Working style

- Keep changes grounded in the repository context.
- Prefer reading the docs and existing files before making new assumptions.
- Explain how the change fits the project goals when describing updates.
- Keep the demo approachable and educational rather than over-engineered.

## Project purpose

This repo exists to demonstrate how Copilot Spaces provide a richer context than a generic chat:
- repository files provide factual context
- project documentation explains intent and direction
- task instructions help define the expected work
- UI and docs make the results easy to understand

## Documentation expectation

When adding new features or changing the demo:
- update the README if the user-facing narrative changes
- update the docs page if the conceptual explanation changes
- keep the app simple and easy to follow
- ensure examples remain aligned with the use case of "grounded software work"

## Code quality

- Prefer clarity over cleverness
- Keep the app lightweight and easy to inspect
- Use semantic, meaningful naming
- Do not add unnecessary dependencies for a demo project

## Goal

The project should feel like a teaching artifact: a compact repo that makes Copilot Spaces easy to understand by showing how context, documentation, and implementation work together.
